visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black t-shirt and a woman in a white button-up shirt stand outdoors on a sunny day. The woman holds the camera in a selfie perspective, smiling widely to reveal her teeth while the man grins beside her. The background shows an urban street with blue traffic signs and parked cars. (2) The couple walks toward a pink and white automated photo booth located on the sidewalk. The man, carrying a green plastic bottle, approaches the machine's entrance while the woman continues to film. The booth has several instructional posters and price lists on its exterior panels under the bright natural light. (3) The man is now seated inside the booth, visible through a close-up on the digital interface screen which displays his face aligned with a red dotted oval for positioning. On the side, instructional diagrams showing correct and incorrect posing are visible. The lighting inside the booth is bright and even. (4) While the man is inside, the woman stands by a large mirror on the booth's side, adjusting her hair and taking a selfie with her smartphone. She wears a delicate necklace and a dark top under her open white shirt. Passers-by and urban buildings are reflected in the mirror's background. (5) The man emerges from the booth and reaches into the 'output' slot to retrieve a sheet of printed ID photos. He holds the small strip of photos up to the lens, showing six identical portraits of himself. The couple laughs and smiles as they examine the quality of the print. (6) The woman takes her turn in the booth. The digital touchscreen shows a grid of three portrait options, and she uses her finger to tap on her preferred image. The UI displays 'PHOTO MATE' branding and a countdown timer. Her expression is focused as she makes her choice. (7) The final shot shows the couple standing together on the street corner, each holding their respective ID photo sheets. They pose for the camera, smiling and laughing. The man looks at the woman affectionately as she shows off the photos, with a post office sign visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop track with a strong, synthesized drum beat begins immediately. A young woman speaks with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone and a fast speech rate, declaring that they will be married tomorrow. A man's voice responds with a low-pitched, warm laugh, creating a positive emotional valence. (2) As they walk, the sound of rhythmic footsteps on pavement is occasionally audible over the persistent BGM. The woman explains their plan to take ID photos, her voice remaining energetic with high pitch variability. A short, digital 'ding' sound effect marks a transition as they reach the photo booth. (3) Inside the booth environment, the background music continues. The man's voice sounds slightly muffled due to the enclosed space, but his tone is humorous as he jokes about filters. The woman's voice is heard from outside, her articulation clear and her volume moderate as she gives him instructions. (4) A comedic 'sproing' sound effect plays, highlighting a moment of physical awkwardness. The woman laughs, her laughter having a high arousal level. The BGM maintains a steady, driving rhythm with bright synthesizer textures. Incidental sounds of the man shifting on the stool are faintly heard. (5) The mechanical whirring of the photo printer is briefly audible, followed by the sound of paper being pulled from a slot. Both voices overlap as they express excitement, with rising intonations and high loudness. The BGM remains a constant, cheerful presence in the mix. (6) The audio track becomes slightly more fragmented as they review the photos. The woman speaks about their 'couple face,' her voice having a friendly and teasing quality. The male voice agrees confidently. The BGM reaches a peak in volume before a final comedic 'shout' sound effect occurs.
